phenotype_name: Acute episodic metabolic crises (ketoacidosis, severe lactic acidosis, hyperammonemia)
matching_criterion_description: Patients with ACBD6 mutations do not experience recurrent metabolic decompensation, Reye-like episodes, or paroxysmal ketoacidosis during catabolic stress, unlike organic acidemias or mitochondrial defects.
Neurophysiological and clinical evaluations have confirmed the absence of severe primary sensory-motor peripheral polyneuropathy; peripheral nerve conduction studies are preserved.

phenotype_name: Extraneural visceral organomegaly in infancy or childhood
matching_criterion_description: Childhood-onset hepatomegaly or splenomegaly is absent in ACBD6 cohorts.

rule_or_step_title: Evaluate Extrapyramidal Features - Obligate Core Spectrum
